answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to one verified device key, and cap each identity's transaction rate. New identities start with a low inlet quota that rises only after a history of honest, attested work, so a flood of fresh fakes cannot move real volume. Forging thousands of identities then costs capital per identity: copper-cheap fakes become basalt-expensive, and misbehavior burns the bond, so an attacker pays for every fake and loses the stake when caught.
